channel.title: objekts — VFX Preproduction and Shoot Planning
channel.description: First-party practical guides for producers, directors and VFX departments preparing hybrid AI/VFX, CGI and practical-effects shoots. Physical production and on-set supervision are separate from remote consulting.

item.title: VFX preproduction & shoot planning — practical versus CG versus generative
item.description: A technical producer-facing breakdown covering shot methodology decisions before filming, camera and lens conditions, on-set HDRI/clean-plate/geometry requirements, decisive PoC and vendor handoff.

item.title: VFX-подготовка съёмок: натура, CGI и генеративные методы
item.description: Русскоязычная инженерная памятка по VFX-breakdown, выбору метода, оптическим условиям, требованиям к данным со съёмочной площадки и передаче шотов в постпродакшен.

item.title: Agent VFX shoot-prep workflow and conditional capture matrix
item.description: An agent-readable shot-preparation guide with method comparison, conditional capture list, PoC acceptance gates, rights and consent boundaries, prepared by objekts as first-party technical information.
